test_title: PYST 32: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held on: 29th November 2021 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Nine students, Ajay, Gita, Navya, Vipin, Pinki, Kabir, Mohan, Saroj and Rani, are standing in a row from left to right according to decreasing order of their heights. Ajay is standing at the middle position. Mohan and Kabir are at the third position from the left and right side, respectively. Gita is at either of the ends of the row. Navya is standing to the immediate left of Ajay. Vipin is the tallest among all nine students. Rani is standing between Ajay and Kabir. Pinki is at the eighth position from the right.

Who is at the second position from the right?
solution: Nine students,** Ajay, Gita, Navya, Vipin, Pinki, Kabir, Mohan, Saroj and Rani,** are standing in a row from left to right according to decreasing order of their heights. 1. Ajay is standing at the middle position. 2. Mohan and Kabir are at the third position from the left and right side, respectively. 3. Navya is standing to the immediate left of Ajay. 4. Rani is standing between Ajay and Kabir. 5. Pinki is at the eighth position from the right .
